newsitem.title: USA: US Justice sues Smithfield Foods in pollution case.
newsitem.headline: US Justice sues Smithfield Foods in pollution case.

text.p: The U.S. Justice Department said Monday it sued Smithfield Foods Inc and two of its subsidiaries for allegedly discharging illegal levels of pollutants at two plants in Virginia.
It said the subsidiaries, Smithfield Packing Co and Gwaltney of Smithfield Ltd, each operate a hog slaughtering and processing facility in Smithfield, where the alleged violations took place.

The lawsuit charged the two facilities dumped illegal levels of pollutants into the Pagan River. The state filed its own lawsuit in August concerning alleged violations at the two plants, the Justice Department said.
It said the lawsuit seeks unspecified civil penalties and a court order requiring that two plants be brought into compliance with the law.
